title.suggested: The Daly-Allen fight in Police Court

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that Judge Cady heard conflicting testimony on the Daly-Allen street fight and fined Tom Allen, Charley Daly and John Ryan $10 each for disturbing the peace.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Thursday, June 21, 1888', page 5.

facts.fact: Allen, Charley Daly and John Ryan were tried before Judge Cady on counter charges of disturbing the peace over the Sunday-morning street fight; Judge Cady called the testimony very mixed and fined each $10
Allen testified that Bob Farrell tripped him and Dan Daly and a crowd kicked him while he was down
places: Seventh and Market streets, St. Louis
facts.quote: There was too many of them to 'urt me. My ribs were kicked, hand hif you don't believe it I'll take hof my clothes hand show you.

notes: Allen is called 'the ex-champion of the world'. Allen showed a bloodshot eye, a cut and discolored ear and a bruise on the face.
